title: Puharich's legal pad: ELF emitter in his television

tellings.quote: installed this ELF uh emitter in his television set so when he would turn on the TV, he would get hit by this

plain: Near the end of his life, around 1994 or 1995, Andrija Puharich, a scientist who studied psychic abilities, wrote on a legal pad that an ELF emitter, a device sending out extremely low frequency radio waves, had been put in his television so that it hit him whenever he turned it on. A researcher on the show, not named, describes the notes without quoting them. If true, it would mean someone was targeting him in his own home.
